requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

adjunct_diet_and_activity.text:
LAB RESULT NOTE — 12/13/2024
Lipid panel reviewed — drawn non-fasting (pt had breakfast). TG not interpretable. Repeat as fasting panel: nothing but water for 10–12 hours before the draw; take usual morning medications. Lab order re-entered; message sent to patient.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 30.8 — plan starting today:
 - Calorie tracking, ~1800 kcal/day; cut late-night snacking and takeout.
 - Gym sessions (treadmill + light weights) 5 days a week, ~150 min/week.
 - Referred to a dietitian-led weight management program; RD intake scheduled.
 Follow-up in ~3–4 months.
2. Low back pain — chronic, stable; strengthening at gym encouraged.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 09/28/2025
Dietitian-led program intake. Food log: small breakfast, moderate lunch, takeout dinner 3–4 nights, snacks after 9 PM (cheese and crackers, wine 1–2 glasses).
Plan: calorie tracking at ~1800 kcal/day; cook at home 5 nights; kitchen closed after 8:30 PM; wine limited to weekends.
Activity: gym 5 days/week, treadmill + light weights, ~150 min/week.
RD follow-up in 6 weeks, then per program.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 04/10/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days, ~1750–1850 kcal. Cooking at home 5 nights. Evening snack now yogurt or fruit.
Adjustments: add protein at breakfast; portion down bread at dinner.
Reports she keeps up with the gym routine.
Continue program; next RD visit in ~2–3 months.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/06/2026
S: Weight follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and program follow-ups since September 2025. Tracking, cooking at home, gym most weekdays. Frustrated — weight 82.8 kg today vs 83.9 kg when the plan began (-1.3%) despite reported adherence. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis. Postmenopausal.
O: Wt 82.8 kg, BMI 30.4. BP 111/68.

A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 30.4 — minimal response to lifestyle program. Start semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly (Wegovy) with standard dose titration from 0.25 mg; counseled on GI side effects, protein intake, and continuing strength training. Continue diet plan. Recheck in 3 months.
2. Low back pain — stable.

Source: Valley Medical Center ED, visit 05/28/2025
55 y/o F, acute right flank pain radiating to groin, nausea. UA: moderate blood. CT: 4 mm right UVJ stone with mild hydronephrosis. Treated with IV fluids, ketorolac, ondansetron. Discharged with tamsulosin, strainer; stone passed 05/30 per callback. Urology follow-up PRN.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 09/06/2025
S: 55 y/o F, would like to lose weight; knees and back ache more, and she has gained steadily since menopause. Snacks late at night; frequent takeout since kids left home. Has a gym membership through retirement community center.
O: Wt 83.9 kg, Ht 165 cm, BMI 30.8. BP 126/79.
Exam unremarkable.

PHARMACIST MEDICATION REVIEW — 10/13/2025
Pt asked about adding fish oil, glucosamine, and a "sleep gummy" (melatonin + L-theanine). No significant interactions with current meds (sertraline, omeprazole, cetirizine, sumatriptan, vitamin D, triamcinolone cream, ibuprofen PRN). Advised glucosamine evidence is limited; melatonin at lowest effective dose.
